_about: Who may call each route handler under app/, checked by `pnpm validate:routes` (scripts/validate-routes.ts, whose header defines the classes).
Keys are URL paths; each exported HTTP method needs an access class and one line of why. A new route.ts fails CI until it has an entry here.

GET.reason: The sentence review dashboard reads a level's verdicts from local files; 404 in production.

POST.reason: Writes a review verdict to data/sentences/decisions with fs; 404 in production.

DELETE.reason: Removes a review verdict from the local decisions file; 404 in production.

POST.reason: Forwards one goal from lib/analytics' sendGoal to DataFast's goals endpoint with the server key; goals only (since 2026-10-16), and a client goal is forgeable by nature.
The feedback form emails Ari or calls a webhook, so it allows 2 per 10 minutes per IP (per warm instance).

GET.reason: Blank genkouyoushi print documents, prerendered for a fixed list of formats.
Kana practice sheets as printable HTML, drawn from public KanjiVG files and cached publicly.
The homepage search's suggestions, ranked on the server from the kanji lists.
Printable kanji practice sheets; strict parameters, cached publicly.
The raw KanjiVG diagram the stroke-order animation swaps in; page content, exempt from robots' /api/ block.

POST.reason: Newsletter and app-waitlist signup; sends a confirmation email, so it allows 2 per 10 minutes per IP (per warm instance).
Adds a contact only for a valid sealed confirm token (or a legacy JWT until 2026-10-20).

GET.reason: Checks the unsubscribe token and renders a confirm form; changes nothing, so a link scanner cannot unsubscribe anyone.

POST.reason: RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe; flips only the contact a valid unsubscribe token names.
Resend's email.received webhook; refuses any request whose Svix signature does not verify.

GET.reason: The stroke-order image Google Images indexes, fetched from KanjiVG through lib/kanjivg.
The homepage search form's GET target; redirects to one kanji page or to /kanji?search=.
